# 1 Clement Chapter 13 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** Therefore, brothers, let us be lowly in mind, laying aside all arrogance and conceit and foolishness and anger, and let us do what is written. For the Holy Spirit says: "Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength, nor the rich man in his riches; but let the one who boasts boast in the Lord, to seek him out and to practice justice and righteousness" — above all being mindful of the words of the Lord Jesus, which he spoke when teaching meekness and long-suffering. [Jer 9:23-24 LXX]

**13:2** For he spoke in this manner: "Show mercy, that you may receive mercy. Forgive, that you may be forgiven. As you do to others, so shall it be done to you. As you give, so shall it be given to you. As you judge, so shall you be judged. As you show kindness, so shall kindness be shown to you. With the measure you measure, by the same measure it shall be measured to you."

---

*LOGOS: the Dominical sayings in 13:2 differ from both Matthew and Luke — likely a free-floating oral tradition. Each saying is a chiasm.*
